name: SiteOps
tagline: Construction project management with live camera safety monitoring that spots falls and hazards.

awards: Aramco Power the Future Track Prize

problem: Construction deaths are high and safety monitoring sits outside project tools, the builder says.
solution: Combines people, machine and ticket tracking with computer vision (detection, tracking, depth estimation) on site feeds and a Gemini agent for monitoring and questions.
demo_moment: Team-described: the dashboard flags a fallen worker from video.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Aramco Power the Future Track Prize” among 160 submissions.
Built solo, with the idea taken from a video game's overview mode.

lessons: Put safety inside the tool managers already use.
